posts.title: Your customers don't quit abruptly. They fade over time: Predicting Retail Churn on Databricks
posts.description: A loyalty member rarely cancels anything. They just come in a little less often, return a little more, stop opening your emails, and one quarter they simply don't show up. By the time the monthly report flags them as "inactive", they've been shopping somewhere else for months. posts.title: One Data Layer, Three Agents: Turning Home appliances IoT Signals into proactive MRO workflow and into Marketing goldmine
posts.description: A connected refrigerator reports its temperature, humidity, energy draw and filter status every few minutes. Most of that data ends up on a dashboard that somebody may or may not look at.
